criteria_results.text: With a real HTTP /event subscriber connected for a directory, a namespace Bus.publish of message.updated AND message.part.updated for that directory must arrive on the /event stream (SyncEvent publishes must reach the per-request DI Bus.Service that /event reads).
criteria_results.notes: Contract test httpapi-event-dual-bus failed on unmodified code, passed after the shared-bus fix. Built-fork real anthropic turn delivered message.updated x6 + message.part.updated x5 + session.updated x3 on /event. User UI smoke: no duplicate messages, token/context gauge populated, live render OK.

process_issues.description: Local dev smoke nearly false-negatived: the opencode engine binds a FIXED port (:4096) and tools/dev/launch_desktop_current.sh starts a second api_server on :4000 that ALSO spawns an engine on :4096, starving the app's :4001 agent server so it reported 'unavailable'/'failed to start'. Verified resolution: nothing else may hold :4096 while the app runs; an identical shell-spawn of the agent server reached ready in ~3s with the staged fix binary. The copied Debug app under /private/tmp also cannot walk up to the repo-local apps/api_server, and GUI-spawn of the adhoc non-notarized binary behaved differently than shell-spawn.
process_issues.detected_by: lsof on :4001/:4096, /opencode/health polling, comparing app-launch vs shell-spawn of the same `npx tsx src/server.ts` command, lsof txt path of the :4096 listener.

process_issues.description: Engine-change smokes require the running :4096 engine to be the freshly-built fork, not the system ~/.opencode/bin/opencode (1.14.40). Staged the build at apps/api_server/opencode_bin/opencode (the dev resolver's first candidate) and verified identity via the unique version string 0.0.0-fix/issue-761-agents-ui-render-202606272206 before trusting the smoke.
process_issues.detected_by: opencode --version on both binaries; lsof txt path of the live :4096 listener.

issues.description: TodoWrite is not enabled in this host context; the checklist was tracked via the host's Task tools (TaskCreate/TaskUpdate) instead. Checklist behavior was preserved, but the literal TodoWrite expansion the SKILL.md names did not occur. Minor / host-limitation, not a discipline lapse.
issues.detected_by: TodoWrite tool-call returned 'No such tool available'; Task tools used as the host equivalent.

suggested_follow_up: Add a dev-smoke helper (or fix tools/dev/launch_desktop_current.sh) that refuses to start a :4000 engine-spawning server, frees :4096 first, and stages+verifies the freshly-built fork at apps/api_server/opencode_bin/opencode before launching — so engine-change smokes can't silently run the stale system binary or fail on port contention. Separately (NOT a #764 criterion): a live run surfaced a Secretary MCP-scoping bug (POST /agent-sessions creates the engine session before profile scope is resolved, so no mcpAllowlist is applied) — file its own issue; tracked in docs/ai/project-state.md.
